summary: Phase 3 Review C PASSES. The API response shape returned by completeRoute.ts and recordGameCompletion matches GameCompletionResultSchema (xpEarned: int≥0, activityId: string, duplicate: boolean, status: literal 200). The HauntedLibraryGame onComplete UX flow uses a stable per-session idempotencyKey (useRef + generateIdempotencyKey), omits the xp field, and the page.tsx POSTs the full 10-field contract payload. Error responses are consistent: 400 with structured {error, issues?, status} for schema violations and invalid JSON; 200 with {duplicate: true, xpEarned: 0} for fire-once duplicates. Contract types (GameCompletionInput, GameCompletionResult) are exported via packages/domain/src/games/index.ts and the ./games subpath export is wired in packages/domain/package.json. Host apps can import the schema, types, XP formula, domain functions, permissions, and error classes from @reading-advantage/domain/games. No blocking findings. Two nonblocking findings documented.

nonblocking_findings.summary: page.tsx handleComplete parameter type is spelled out inline (10 fields) rather than importing GameCompletionInput from @reading-advantage/domain/games. The component already defines its own HauntedLibraryCompletionPayload type that mirrors the schema. If the schema changes, both inline types must be updated manually.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: apps/advantage-games/src/app/[locale]/(student)/student/games/sentence/haunted-library/page.tsx lines 74-85 spell out the full type. The component at HauntedLibraryGame.tsx lines 31-42 defines HauntedLibraryCompletionPayload separately. Neither imports GameCompletionInput from the domain package.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Phase 5+ migration can replace the inline types with imports of GameCompletionInput from @reading-advantage/domain/games. Not a Phase 3 blocker — the types currently match the schema exactly.

nonblocking_findings.summary: GameEndScreen displays client-side calculateXP(gameState) rather than the server-computed xpEarned from the POST response. The page.tsx reads data.xpEarned and stores it via setLastResult, but the end screen renders before the async POST completes.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: HauntedLibraryGame.tsx line 203: xp={calculateXP(gameState)}. Decision 3.5/3.7: 'The end-screen may show XP: (pending) or the client-side preview until the server response arrives.' The server response is used for persistence (host apps) and the game store.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: This is documented behavior per Decision 3.5/3.7. No action needed. Phase 5+ host import may add a loading state or use the server response for the end screen display.

evidence: API response shape verified: completeRoute.ts returns { xpEarned: number, activityId: string, duplicate: boolean, status: 200 } matching gameCompletionResultSchema. mutations.ts returns the same shape (with duplicate:true, xpEarned:0 on retry).

HauntedLibraryGame.tsx onComplete payload: HauntedLibraryCompletionPayload type has 10 fields matching GameCompletionInputSchema (no xp). idempotencyKey generated once per session via useRef (lines 73-77). Test asserts payload has no xp property.

page.tsx POST body sends all 10 required fields (gameType, difficulty, score, accuracy, correctAnswers, totalAttempts, duration, victory, idempotencyKey, clientTimestamp). Reads data.xpEarned from response for setLastResult.

Error responses: completeRoute.ts returns 400 with {error, issues?, status} for schema violations (line 43-49) and invalid JSON (line 34-37). mutations.ts returns {duplicate: true, xpEarned: 0, status: 200} for fire-once duplicates.

Contract exports: packages/domain/src/games/index.ts exports schema, types, calculateGameXP, recordGameCompletion, getGameCompletions, GAMES_PERMISSIONS, and error classes. packages/domain/package.json has ./games subpath export.
completeRoute.ts imports gameCompletionInputSchema and calculateGameXP from @reading-advantage/domain/games — contract delegation verified.
All 3 test suites pass: 394 domain tests (0 failed), 7 completeRoute tests (0 failed), 12 HauntedLibraryGame tests (0 failed). Lint clean on both filters. check-types clean on both filters.
